We need to determine number of methyl groups in the sample's molecule. We have no direct description of molecule. We can get NMR spectra to infer. Use proton NMR to see methyl signals (singlet around 0.9 ppm). Could also use carbon NMR for methyl carbons (~10-30 ppm). We need to count distinct methyl groups. Use proton NMR to see number of methyl signals and integration. But integration not given. The tool returns spectra as string maybe includes peaks with integration? Not sure. Could also use HSQC to correlate.

Simplify: Use proton NMR first.
